# Production Master [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.3--beta-blue)](https://github.com/TamirCohen-Wix/production-master/releases/tag/v1.0.3-beta) [![CI](https://github.com/TamirCohen-Wix/production-master/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/TamirCohen-Wix/production-master/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Author](https://img.shields.io/badge/author-Tamir%20Cohen-green)](https://wix.slack.com/team/U09H3AHE3C7) [![Claude Code Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Claude%20Code-Plugin-blueviolet)](apps/claude/README.md) [![Cursor Adapter Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cursor-Plugin-6f42c1)](apps/cursor/README.md) Autonomous production investigation **platform** with a shared core engine and three surfaces: Claude Code plugin, Cursor IDE plugin, and Cloud REST API. The two primary interactive plugin adapters are `apps/claude/` and `apps/cursor/`. > [!WARNING] > **Beta.** For the Claude Code surface, try it **per-session first** before installing persistently. Use **`local` scope** (the default) to limit blast radius. > [!CAUTION] > **MCP connectivity can be unstable.** A full investigation takes ~40 minutes. If you hit MCP errors, check [#mcp-gw-support](https://wix.slack.com/archives/C093RAT0NLS). ## Quick Start Pick your surface and follow the setup guide: - If you use Claude Code, start with the [Claude adapter setup guide](apps/claude/README.md). - If you use Cursor, follow the [Cursor adapter setup guide](apps/cursor/README.md). - If you deploy the service, use the [Cloud adapter deployment guide](services/production-master/README.md). After setup, run your first investigation from Claude Code: ```text /production-master SCHED-45895 ``` For troubleshooting and operational recovery steps, see the [troubleshooting guide](docs/user-guide/troubleshooting.md). ## Adapters At A Glance - `apps/claude/`: Claude Code plugin commands, hooks, install/validation scripts, and plugin lifecycle behavior. - `apps/cursor/`: Cursor plugin rules, commands, agents, hooks, and IDE-native workflow configuration. - `services/production-master/`: Cloud adapter for REST API, workers, and deployment automation. ## Platform Architecture ```mermaid graph TD PM["Production Master Platform"] PM --> CC["Claude Code Plugin
(Interactive CLI)"] PM --> CU["Cursor IDE Plugin
(IDE-native)"] PM --> CL["Cloud Service
(REST API / Webhooks)"] CC --> CORE["Shared Core Engine"] CU --> CORE CL --> CORE CORE --> AGENTS["Investigation Agents"] CORE --> SKILLS["Skill Library"] CORE --> ORCH["Orchestrator"] CORE --> DOMAIN["Domain Config"] CORE --> OUTPUT["Output Styles"] CORE --> MCP["MCP Server Integrations
Grafana · Jira · Slack · GitHub
Octocode · FT-Release · Fire Console
Grafana-MCP · Context7 · Devex · Docs-Schema
KB-Retrieval · DB-Core · Trino · Root-Cause"] ``` This diagram is an overview only. For pipeline internals and data flow, read the [architecture documentation](docs/architecture/overview.md). ## Repository Structure ``` production-master/ ├── core/ # Shared, adapter-agnostic logic │ ├── agents/ # Investigation agents │ ├── skills/ # Skill definitions │ ├── output-styles/ # Report & publisher formats │ ├── orchestrator/ # Pipeline orchestration logic │ ├── domain/ # Domain config schema & loading │ │ └── examples/ # Reference domain config samples │ ├── tests/ # Core unit tests │ └── mcp-servers.json # MCP server definitions ├── apps/claude/ # Claude Code adapter │ ├── commands/ # Slash commands for Claude Code │ ├── hooks/ # Claude Code lifecycle hooks │ ├── scripts/ # Install, validate, sync scripts │ └── tests/ # Adapter-specific tests ├── apps/cursor/ # Cursor IDE adapter │ ├── rules/ # Cursor-specific rule files │ ├── commands/ # Cursor command definitions │ ├── agents/ # Cursor agent configurations │ ├── hooks/ # Lifecycle hooks │ └── tests/ # Adapter-specific tests ├── services/production-master/ # Cloud adapter / REST service │ ├── src/ # API, workers, MCP client, storage │ ├── helm/ # Kubernetes Helm charts │ ├── migrations/ # Database migrations │ └── tests/ # Unit, integration, e2e tests ├── docs/ # User-facing documentation ├── docs/platform-design-docs/ # Architecture & design documents ├── mcp-servers.json # Root MCP server config ├── apps/cursor/models.json # Cursor adapter model config (inside adapter) ``` ## Install ### Claude Code ```bash gh repo clone TamirCohen-Wix/production-master && cd production-master bash apps/claude/scripts/install.sh ``` The installer registers the plugin, configures settings, and enables agent teams. If `PRODUCTION_MASTER_ACCESS_KEY` is not set, the plugin will guide you through authentication automatically on first use. **Quick trial (per-session, nothing installed):** ```bash claude --plugin-dir ./production-master ```
Plugin scopes & management (Claude Code) #### Plugin scopes | Scope | Location | Shared via git? | Best for | |-------|----------|-----------------|----------| | **`local`** (default) | `.claude/plugins/` in project | No | Trying it out | | `project` | `.claude/plugins/` in project | Yes | Team sharing | | `user` | `~/.claude/plugins/` | No | All projects | #### Plugin management ```bash claude plugin list # Show installed plugins claude plugin install production-master --scope local # Install claude plugin uninstall production-master --scope local # Uninstall claude plugin marketplace remove production-master # Remove marketplace bash apps/claude/scripts/validate-install.sh # Diagnose issues ```
### Cursor IDE ```bash gh repo clone TamirCohen-Wix/production-master cd production-master cursor apps/cursor ``` Set `PRODUCTION_MASTER_ACCESS_KEY` in your environment for MCP auth. See the [auth guide](docs/user-guide/auth.md) for how to get your key. Then follow the step-by-step setup in the [Cursor installation guide](apps/cursor/README.md) to verify MCP connectivity and run your first command. ### Cloud Service ```bash cd services/production-master cp .env.example .env # Edit with your API keys docker compose up -d # API at http://localhost:3000 ``` For deployment details (including Wix Serverless), follow the [Cloud deployment guide](services/production-master/README.md). ## Usage Commands below use Claude Code slash-command syntax. Cursor and Cloud surfaces expose equivalent capabilities through their own UX/API. ``` /production-master SCHED-45895 # Full investigation /production-master get errors from bookings-service last 2h # Query logs /production-master trace 1769611570.535540810122211411840 # Trace request /production-master show me error rate for bookings-service # Query metrics /production-master search slack for SCHED-45895 # Search Slack /production-master check toggle specs.bookings.SomeToggle # Check toggles ``` ### Commands | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/production-master` | Full investigation pipeline | | `/grafana-query` | Query Grafana logs & metrics | | `/slack-search` | Search Slack discussions | | `/production-changes` | Find PRs, commits, and feature toggle changes | | `/resolve-artifact` | Validate and resolve service artifact IDs | | `/fire-console` | Query domain objects via Fire Console gRPC | | `/update-context` | Create or update your domain config | | `/git-update-agents` | Sync agent updates back to the repo | | `/production-master-report` | Submit bug reports, enhancements, or questions via GitHub issue | ### Command options and flags Every command supports `--help` to show its full usage, flags, and examples: ``` /production-master --help /grafana-query --help ``` The main pipeline supports these flags: ``` /production-master SCHED-45895 --skip-slack # Skip Slack search /production-master SCHED-45895 --skip-grafana # Skip Grafana log analysis /production-master SCHED-45895 --service my-svc # Override primary service name /production-master SCHED-45895 --verbose # Show detailed agent outputs ``` You can also use natural language — the orchestrator classifies your intent automatically: ``` /production-master errors from bookings-service since 2pm # → QUERY_LOGS mode /production-master what PRs were merged to scheduler this week # → SEARCH_CODE mode ``` ### Set up your repo Run `/update-context` from your repo in Claude Code. It analyzes your repo, asks a few questions, and generates a domain config (`domain.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, `MEMORY.md`). With a domain config, the pipeline works autonomously — without one, it asks for service names and artifact IDs during the investigation. ## Architecture The orchestrator classifies intent, gathers context, generates testable hypotheses, and iterates through a verification loop with specialized agents. See the [architecture overview](docs/architecture/overview.md) for pipeline design, data flow, and agent details. ## Documentation For full documentation, start at the [documentation hub](docs/README.md). ## Updating To update to the latest version (Claude Code): ```bash claude plugin update production-master ``` To install a specific version: ```bash git checkout v1.0.3-beta # Switch to a specific release tag bash apps/claude/scripts/install.sh ``` To downgrade: ```bash git checkout v1.0.1-beta # Any previous tag bash apps/claude/scripts/install.sh ``` > All available versions are listed on the [releases page](https://github.com/TamirCohen-Wix/production-master/releases). ## Feature Requests & Bug Reports - **Request a feature:** [Open an issue](https://github.com/TamirCohen-Wix/production-master/issues/new?labels=enhancement&template=feature_request.md) with the `enhancement` label - **Report a bug:** [Open an issue](https://github.com/TamirCohen-Wix/production-master/issues/new?labels=bug&template=bug_report.md) with the `bug` label - **Ask a question:** [Start a discussion](https://github.com/TamirCohen-Wix/production-master/discussions) ## Contributing ```bash gh repo fork TamirCohen-Wix/production-master --clone cd production-master claude --plugin-dir . # Test changes per-session ``` PRs to `main` require passing CI and 1 approving review. See the [contributing guide](docs/contributing.md). ## Requirements | Surface | Requirements | |---------|-------------| | **Claude Code** | [Claude Code CLI](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code), [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com) (`gh`), [MCP access key](docs/user-guide/auth.md) | | **Cursor IDE** | [Cursor IDE](https://cursor.com) v0.40+, [MCP access key](docs/user-guide/auth.md) | | **Cloud** | Node.js 22+, Docker, PostgreSQL 16+, Redis 7+ | --- Made by [Tamir Cohen](https://wix.slack.com/team/U09H3AHE3C7)
files.apps/claude/README.md:
# Production Master — Claude Code Adapter

> **Sibling adapters:** [Cursor](../cursor/README.md) | [Cloud](../../services/production-master/README.md)

This adapter connects the shared Production Master engine to Claude Code (commands, hooks, and runtime wiring).

## Who this is for

Use this adapter if you want to run Production Master investigations directly from Claude Code with slash commands.

## Prerequisites

- Claude Code CLI installed and available as `claude`
- GitHub CLI installed and authenticated as `gh`
- `jq` JSON processor installed (on macOS with Homebrew the installer will attempt to install it automatically; on Linux install via your package manager, e.g. `apt-get install jq`)
- MCP access key from <https://mcp-s-connect.wewix.net/mcp-servers>

## Quick Start - Try Per-Session First

> **Warning**
> This adapter is beta. Start per-session first, then persist only after validation.

Nothing is installed. Session-only mode is removed when you close Claude Code:

```bash
gh repo clone TamirCohen-Wix/production-master
cd production-master
claude --plugin-dir apps/claude
```

If `PRODUCTION_MASTER_ACCESS_KEY` is not set, the plugin will guide you through authentication automatically on first use. See [auth guide](../docs/user-guide/auth.md) for manual setup.

Then run this inside Claude Code:

```text
/production-master SCHED-45895
```

## Install

### Option A: Native plugin install (recommended)

Inside Claude Code, run:

```text
/plugin marketplace add TamirCohen-Wix/production-master
/plugin install production-master
```

If `PRODUCTION_MASTER_ACCESS_KEY` is not set, the plugin will guide you through authentication automatically. Or set it manually — see [auth guide](../docs/user-guide/auth.md).

### Option B: Installer script

```bash
gh repo clone TamirCohen-Wix/production-master
cd production-master
bash apps/claude/scripts/install.sh
```

The installer will prompt for scope, configure status line, and enable agent teams. MCP servers are auto-loaded from the plugin's `.mcp.json` file — no manual injection into `~/.claude.json` needed.

### Plugin Scopes

| Scope | Location | Shared via git? | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `local` (recommended) | project-local Claude config | No | trial and safe rollout |
| `project` | project Claude config | Yes | shared team setup |
| `user` | `~/.claude` | No | all projects on one machine |

### Plugin Management

```bash
claude plugin list
claude plugin install production-master --scope local
claude plugin uninstall production-master --scope local
claude plugin update production-master
bash apps/claude/scripts/validate-install.sh
```

## Upgrade / Downgrade

Upgrade to latest on your current branch:

```bash
git pull --ff-only
bash apps/claude/scripts/install.sh
```

Pin to a specific release tag or commit:

```bash
git fetch --tags --prune origin
git checkout v1.1.0
# or: git checkout <commit-sha>
bash apps/claude/scripts/install.sh
```

Return to the latest `main`:

```bash
git checkout main
git pull --ff-only
bash apps/claude/scripts/install.sh
```

Installer writes are warning-gated and require explicit confirmation by default.

## First-run checklist

1. Run `/production-master --help`.
2. Run `bash apps/claude/scripts/validate-install.sh`.
3. Run `/production-master SCHED-45895` (or another test ticket).
4. Confirm outputs are written under `.claude/debug/`.

## Usage examples

```text
/production-master SCHED-45895
/production-master get errors from bookings-service last 2h
/production-master check toggle specs.bookings.SomeToggle
```

## Configuration

- Hooks are defined in `hooks/hooks.json`.
- Scripts live in `scripts/` and are referenced from hook configuration.
- `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` must resolve correctly for hook script paths to work.
- MCP servers are auto-loaded from `.mcp.json` in the plugin directory.
- `settings.json` in the plugin directory provides default env vars (agent teams).

## Why install script vs plugin command

`claude plugin install production-master --scope <scope>` installs the plugin package itself, but does not bootstrap all runtime wiring this adapter expects.

The installer exists to provide a single guided setup that can also:
- register/update the local marketplace entry and install with selected scope,
- optionally configure status line command in `~/.claude/settings.json`,
- enable `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1` in settings.

MCP servers are auto-loaded from the plugin's `.mcp.json` file and no longer need manual injection into `~/.claude.json`.

If you prefer minimal changes, stay with per-session mode (`claude --plugin-dir apps/claude`) and configure only what you need manually.

## Structure

| Directory | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `.claude-plugin/` | Plugin manifest (`plugin.json`) and marketplace listing (`marketplace.json`) |
| `.mcp.json` | MCP server definitions (auto-loaded by Claude Code) |
| `settings.json` | Default plugin settings (env vars) |
| `hooks/` | Claude Code hook definitions (`hooks.json`) |
| `scripts/` | Install, validate, release, sync, and status line scripts |
| `commands/` | Slash command definitions, including `production-master-feedback.md` |
| `tests/` | Adapter-level validation scripts |

## Relationship to shared core

Core orchestration, domain logic, output styles, and agent definitions live in [`core/`](../core). This adapter provides the Claude Code integration layer.

## Troubleshooting

- If install succeeds but commands fail, run `bash apps/claude/scripts/validate-install.sh`.
- If hooks do not execute, verify `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` path resolution and `hooks/hooks.json` script paths.
- For MCP connectivity failures, check [#mcp-gw-support](https://wix.slack.com/archives/C093RAT0NLS).

## Contributing

See the repository [contributing guide](../docs/contributing.md) and [documentation index](../docs/README.md) for contribution workflow and standards.

For this repository's PR governance:
- Use branch names in `<area>/<description>` format where area is `cursor`, `claude`, `infra`, `common`, or `cloud`.
- Include `#auto-merge` in PR description to arm squash auto-merge after checks/reviews pass.
- Use `#cancel-auto-merge` in PR description or comments to disable it.
